title: Generation of 2C-like mouse embryonic stem cells in vivo to evaluate developmental potency
protocol: Seed NELFA reporter mESCs at 1.2 × 10^5 per well of a 6-well plate in 3 mL of standard mESC medium containing LIF and 2i (1 μM PD0325901 and 3 μM CHIR99021).
Culture cells on gelatin coated (0.1% w/v, 24 h) 6-well plates in an incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Discard spent medium the following day and transfer 3 mL of fresh medium containing 4 mM 2-DG to the reporter cells. This is day 1 of treatment.
Dissolve 2-DG powder in sterile water to prepare a 1 M stock solution.
Make 50 μL single-use aliquots and store at -20°C for up to 6 months.
Discard thawed leftover solutions.
Add 4 μL of the 1 M 2-DG stock solution per mL of culture medium daily.
Transfer 3 mL of fresh medium containing 4 mM 2-DG into the culture.
Repeat this step until cells have been treated for a total of 4 days.
Monitor reporter cells under a fluorescence microscope daily to assess treatment effectiveness.
Discard culture medium by aspiration.
Wash 2C-reporter mESCs twice with 2 mL of sterile PBS.
Add 0.3 mL of room temperature (22°C–25°C) 0.25% trypsin to dislodge the cells.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 2 min during trypsin treatment.
Add 0.7 mL of mESC medium to quench trypsin.
Collect cells by centrifugation at 200 g for 5 min at room temperature (22°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 mL of mESC medium containing freshly prepared 4 mM 2-DG.
Strain cells through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Place cells on ice until flow cytometry commences.
Adopt strict gating boundaries for every flow cytometry setup by including negative control cells (no EGFP or mCherry).
Fine tune the plate voltages and laser intensities to obtain clear separation of singlets and doublets in scatter plots.
Define boundaries for EGFP-negative cells in the control group and record an average of 10,000 events for reference.
Unload control cells and rinse the cell sorter with sterile water for 2 min.
Load 2-DG treated mESCs.
Record an average of 10,000 events for reference using the same voltages and laser intensity.
Define boundaries of EGFP positive cells that show clear separation from the bulk EGFP negative population.
Sort cells at the slowest speed setting using a 100 μm nozzle to ensure maximal cell viability.
Typically sort 1 × 10^4 to 3 × 10^5 EGFP-positive and EGFP-negative cells respectively.
Sort EGFP-positive cells into a 5 mL collection tube containing 1 mL of ESC medium supplemented with 4 mM 2-DG.
Chill the sorting chamber at 4°C throughout the entire process.
Flush the cell sorter briefly with FACS buffer.
Analyze sorted cells on the cell sorter to determine sort purity.
Perform post-sort purity checks to verify minimal cross contamination between EGFP-positive and negative populations, and ensure all cells are mCherry-positive.
Obtain the intended number of cells for each population and place them on ice.
Set up a second sort using the same gating parameters to obtain another set of EGFP-negative and positive populations.
Flush the cell sorter with sterile water for 2 minutes.
Load enriched cell populations from the second sort into the cell sorter iteratively.
Record an average of 10,000 events to achieve approximately 95% pure EGFP-positive populations.
Recalibrate the cell sorter’s laser with fluorophore standards if post-sorting purity is less than 80% and repeat sorting with more stringent gating parameters.
Transport flow sorted cells on ice promptly for embryo microinjection.

Set aside some cells from the same batch for gene expression profiling using qPCR to ensure upregulation of 2C restricted transcripts such as MERVL, Dux, and Zscan4c in EGFP-positive cells compared to EGFP-negative population.
Re-culture a subset of sorted cells on gelatin-coated plates to assess cell viability and sterility post-sorting.
Centrifuge flow cytometry enriched mESCs at 200 g for 3 min at 4°C.
Discard FACS buffer supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the collected cells in 500 μL of M2 culture medium.
Keep resuspended cells at 4°C until injection.
Sort EGFP-positive and EGFP-negative cells during each flow cytometry session.
Resuspend sorted cells gently in 500 μL of M2 medium.
Pre-warm M2 and KSOM media in a 37°C incubator supplemented with 5% CO2.
Sacrifice donor ICR female mice by cervical dislocation at 2.5 days post-coitum (dpc).
Dissect out the fallopian tubes immediately after sacrifice.
Flush pre-warmed M2 medium into the fallopian tube to harvest 8-cell stage embryos using a sterile syringe with a 27G needle.
Transfer harvested embryos to a petri dish filled with pre-warmed KSOM medium.
Wash the harvested embryos five times in drops of pre-warmed KSOM medium iteratively.
Mouth pipette the embryos carefully to the first drop of KSOM.
Transfer the embryos from the first drop to the second drop of KSOM medium and repeat until the 5th drop.
Pick healthy 8-cell stage embryos from the pool of washed embryos.
Set aside picked embryos in a separate petri dish containing pre-warmed KSOM medium.
Place healthy embryos in a 37°C incubator supplemented with 5% CO2 until injection.
Pre-warm the KSOM medium in the 37°C incubator for at least 30 min in advance.
Prepare holding and injection pipettes using the micropipette puller and microforge.
Mount the holding pipette and injection needle onto the microinjector.
Setup multiple 50 μL drops of M2 medium in a clean petri dish cover.
Cover 50 μL of M2 medium drops completely with 200 μL of mineral oil.
Carefully mouth pipette 8–10 embryos into each M2-mineral droplet.
Retrieve the FACS sorted mESCs from 4°C and gently pipette to mix.
Carefully mouth pipette the sorted cells into a glass capillary, ensuring that there are no bubbles.
For each droplet containing the embryos, release a small number of mESCs into each droplet.
Place the prepared petri dish on the stage of an inverted light microscope.
Carefully transfer the holding and injection pipettes into the droplets containing the embryos and mESCs.
Inject 5–7 NELFAhigh or NELFAlow mESCs into the cell space of 8-cell stage embryos by piercing through the zona pellucida.
Transfer carefully the injected chimeric embryos into a fresh petri dish containing KSOM medium.
Place the petri dish in an incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 48 hours before immunofluorescence staining.
Remove the injected embryos from the incubator when reaching approximately late E4.5 stage.
Carefully remove microinjected chimeric embryos using a mouth pipette.
Wash the embryos 3–4 times in consecutive 100 μL drops of PBS with 1% BSA.
Fix the embryos with 4% paraformaldehyde at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Transfer the fixed embryos into a 4-well dish containing PBS with 1% BSA using a mouth pipette.
Aspirate and discard the PFA according to institutional safety regulations.
Incubate the embryos in PBS + 1% BSA covering them completely for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Repeat the wash steps twice, totaling three washes of the embryos.
Store embryos in sterile PBS with 1% BSA at 4°C for several days if necessary.
Cover the PBS containing stored embryos with a layer of mineral oil to prevent evaporation.
Permeabilize and block the embryos with IF blocking buffer for 1 hour at room temperature (22°C–25°C).
Prepare primary antibody dilutions in IF blocking buffer during the blocking step incubation.
Gently aspirate and remove the blocking buffer from the well.
Add the primary antibody solution to the embryos.
Incubate the primary antibody for 12 hours at 4°C.
Transfer the embryos using a mouth pipette into a 4-well dish containing IF blocking buffer.
Incubate the embryos in IF blocking buffer at room temperature (22°C–25°C) for 5 minutes.
Aspirate and discard the primary antibody solution.
Repeat the washing step with IF blocking buffer for a total of 3 washes.
Prepare secondary antibody dilutions.
Add 1 μL of Alexa Fluor 594 Donkey Anti-Rabbit IgG (H+L) to 0.5 mL of IF blocking buffer.
Add 2 μL of Alexa Fluor 647 Rabbit Anti-Mouse IgG (H+L) to the mixture.
Add 0.5 μL of DAPI solution to the mixture.
Mix well and add the secondary antibody solution to the embryos.
Perform secondary antibody incubation at room temperature (22°C–25°C) for 1 h, protected from light.
Discard the secondary antibody solution carefully.
Transfer the embryos into another well containing IF blocking buffer.
Incubate at room temperature (22°C–25°C) for 5 min.
Discard the IF blocking buffer.
Repeat steps 15 and 16 for a total of 3 washes.
Wash the embryos once with 1× PBS + 1% BSA.
Make a microdrop of PBS on the glass surface of a 35 mm glass-bottom dish.
Cover the microdrop with mineral oil.
Carefully transfer the embryos into the microdrops using a mouth pipette.
Acquire images using the appropriate confocal microscope configurations.
